AUTH_RATE_LIMITED: Mwayesa kulowa kambiri koma sizinatheke. Chonde yesaninso pambuyo pake.
AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID: Kulowa kwanu kwatha nthawi kapena sikoyenera. Chonde lowaninso.
USER_TOKEN_REQUIRED: Pempho ili likufuna chizindikiro cha wogwiritsa ntchito.
USER_TOKEN_INVALID: Chizindikiro cha pempho lanu sichoyenera. Tsitsaninso tsambali ndipo yesaninso.
SITE_TOKEN_REQUIRED: Pempho ili likufuna chizindikiro cha webusaiti.
SITE_TOKEN_INVALID: Chizindikiro cha webusaiti sichoyenera. Tsitsaninso tsambali ndipo yesaninso.
SITE_ACCESS_DENIED: Mulibe chilolezo cholowa pa webusaiti iyi.
USER_NOT_SET_UP: Wogwiritsa ntchitoyo sanakonzebe HAXIAM. Ayenera kulowa kaye.
USER_ALREADY_HAS_ACCESS: Wogwiritsa ntchitoyo ali kale ndi chilolezo pa webusaiti iyi.
FEATURE_DISABLED_OUTLINE: Kusintha kapangidwe ka masamba kwatsekedwa pa webusaiti iyi.
FEATURE_DISABLED_ADD_PAGE: Kuwonjezera masamba kwatsekedwa pa webusaiti iyi.
FEATURE_DISABLED_PAGE_DETAILS: Kusintha zambiri za tsamba kwatsekedwa pa webusaiti iyi.
FEATURE_DISABLED_FILES: Ntchito za mafayilo zatsekedwa pa webusaiti iyi.
FEATURE_DISABLED_UPLOAD: Kukweza zithunzi ndi mawu kwatsekedwa pa webusaiti iyi.
FEATURE_DISABLED_SETTINGS: Zokonda izi zatsekedwa pa webusaiti iyi.
FEATURE_DISABLED: Ntchito iyi yatsekedwa pa webusaiti iyi.
INPUT_TOO_LARGE: Zomwe mwalemba ndi zazikulu kwambiri (zochuluka kwambiri ndi ma byte {maxBytes}).
FILE_RATE_LIMITED: Ntchito za mafayilo zachuluka kwambiri pa webusaiti iyi. Yesaninso pakatha {retryAfter}.
SITE_NAME_INVALID: Mayina a webusaiti angagwiritse ntchito zilembo, manambala, mizere yaifupi ndi mizere yapansi basi.
USER_NAME_INVALID: Mayina olowera angagwiritse ntchito zilembo, manambala, mizere yaifupi ndi mizere yapansi basi.
SITE_CONTEXT_UNRESOLVED: Sizinatheke kupeza webusaiti ya pempho ili.
SITE_THEME_INVALID: Mutu wa kaonekedwe umenewo sungagwiritsidwe ntchito pa webusaiti yatsopano.
ITEM_COUNT_MISMATCH: Chiwerengero cha masamba chasintha mosayembekezereka, choncho palibe chomwe chasungidwa.
PAGE_BREAK_REQUIRED: Zomwe zili mkati ziyenera kukhala ndi chogawa tsamba. Zomwe zili pambuyo pake zokha ndi zomwe zimasungidwa.
REVISION_RESTORE_FAILED: Sizinatheke kubwezeretsa mtundu umenewo wa tsamba.
ALT_FORMATS_FAILED: Sizinatheke kusintha mitundu ina ya webusaiti iyi.
FILE_EXISTS: Fayilo ya dzina ili ilipo kale.
FILE_NAME_INVALID: Dzina la fayilo limenelo silingagwiritsidwe ntchito.
UPLOAD_WRONG_TYPE: Mtundu wa fayilo ndi wolakwika. Zimayembekezeredwa {expected}.
UPLOAD_NOT_VALID: Fayilo yokwezedwa si fayilo yoyenera ya {expected}.
UPLOAD_XLS_UNSUPPORTED: Mafayilo akale a .xls sathandizidwa. Sungani fayilo ngati .xlsx ndipo yesaninso.
UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: Fayilo ndi yayikulu kuposa malire okweza a {maxMb} MB.
DECK_NAME_FAILED: Sizinatheke kupeza dzina la deck kuchokera ku dzina la fayilo.
IMAGE_RASTER_ONLY: Zithunzi za raster zokha (monga JPG kapena PNG) ndi zomwe zingasinthidwe motere.
IMAGE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: Mtundu wa chithunzi uwu sungasinthidwe pomwe ulili.
IMAGE_SUPPORT_UNAVAILABLE: Kusintha zithunzi sikupezeka pa seva iyi.
SEARCH_QUERY_TOO_LONG: Kusaka ndi kwautali kwambiri (zilembo {max} zochuluka kwambiri).
SEARCH_TEXT_TOO_SHORT: Mawu osaka ayenera kukhala oposa chilembo chimodzi kuti asinthidwe.
REPLACE_TEXT_TOO_SHORT: Mawu olowa m'malo ayenera kukhala opanda kanthu kapena oposa chilembo chimodzi.
REMOVE_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Kuchotsa mawu ofanana kukufuna chitsimikizo chachiwiri.
SEARCH_NO_MATCHES: Mawu osaka sanapezeke m'zomwe zili pa webusaiti.
STYLE_GUIDE_EXTERNAL: Chitsogozo cha kalembedwe chimachokera kumalo akunja ndipo sichingasinthidwe mu HAXcms.
